mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing clear skies and 54 degrees at Badger Prairie County Park, with a waning gibbous moon visible in the sky.

The City of Verona is sharing engineering reports for City Council review, and the Wisconsin Department of Transportation is hosting meetings for the US 18/151 Corridor Study with both in-person and virtual options available to discuss design concepts.

There is plenty to do in town, with live music at Paddy Mac's, yoga at Insight Wellness, and pizza at Lake Lou-ee all happening today. Looking ahead, you can enjoy Main Street Trick or Treat tomorrow and trivia at Hop Haus tomorrow.
In our weekly report, officers responded on October 25 to a report of a vehicle stopped at Plympton Street and Rita Avenue, where they arrested a local man for O W I.
Today is the perfect day to enjoy some Chocolate Heath Crunch, and the Verona Culver's will be ready for you when they open today at 10:00 AM.
